story.titleZh: 新加坡大奖赛第42圈：小红牛车队领先，莱科宁领先莱维斯8秒，查尔斯落后16秒
story.summaryZh: 新加坡大奖赛进行中，小红牛车队领先，莱科宁领先莱维斯8秒，查尔斯落后16秒。伊萨克获得第13位，并刷新了最快圈速。
story.originalTitle: LAP 42/62: We're back under Green Flag conditions 🟢 Max leads Lewis by eight seconds; Charles is another eight seconds down the road, having made a...
story.summaryEn:
LAP 42/62: We're back under Green Flag conditions 🟢
Max leads Lewis by eight seconds; Charles is another eight seconds down the road, having made an extra stop.
Isack is P13, with the fastest lap of the race 🟣
#F1 || #SingaporeGP 🇸🇬Oracle Red Bull Racing: LAP 39/62: Lance has stopped out on track... so we have a VSC. That's the race neutralised, for now.
#F1 || #SingaporeGP 🇸🇬
detailZh:
LAP 42/62: 我们回到了绿灯旗条件下 🟢
Max领先Lewis 8秒；Charles落后16秒，因为多停了一次站。
Isack排名第13位，刷新了本站的最高圈速 🟣
#F1 || #SingaporeGP 🇸🇬Oracle 红牛 Racing: LAP 39/62: Lance在赛道上停车... 因此我们有了虚拟安全车。目前比赛已被中立化。
#F1 || #SingaporeGP 🇸🇬
